entry.name: array.tobuffer
entry.digest: Write array object values to an audio buffer
entry.description: Values are assumed to be between and . If the array contains multichannel data, each channel should be wrapped inside of a subarray (e.g. [ [ -1, 0, 1 ], [ -1, 0, -1 ] ]).
